tools.name: generate_pdf
tools.description: Create a professionally formatted, paginated PDF from Markdown. Returns a short-lived download capability.

tools.name: get_pdf_job
tools.description: Read the status for a PDF job using its unguessable capability.

tools.name: inspect_pdf
tools.description: Inspect a previously uploaded PDF using its document capability. Upload binary PDFs through POST /v1/documents; persist both the returned capability and recovery key securely.

tools.name: get_document_map
tools.description: Return page labels, sizes, native-text previews, bookmarks, and sparse-text warnings. Set page to include up to 500 positioned text blocks for that page.

tools.name: search_document
tools.description: Find exact normalized text matches in native PDF text (no OCR). Results and excerpts are bounded.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read extractable native text from up to 10 selected pages. Output is limited to 32,000 characters; scanned pages need OCR, which is not provided.

tools.name: verify_document_citation
tools.description: Check that a quote of 5 to 500 characters appears on the stated page in extracted native text. This does not establish truth or visual reading order.

tools.name: compare_pdfs
tools.description: Compare page count and normalized native text between two separately authorized uploaded PDFs. Image-only and visual differences are not compared.

tools.name: validate_pdf_text
tools.description: Check that the PDF parses, has an optional expected page count, and contains required text. This does not perform PDF/A, signature, visual, or OCR validation.

tools.name: render_pdf_page_region
tools.description: Render one authorized PDF page crop as PNG. x/y/width/height are normalized 0-1 page fractions; output is bounded to four million pixels.
